title: ECB’s Kazimir: Will consider all options for next policy decision
summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), Peter Kazimir, said during the European trading session on Monday that he is “increasingly concerned about gas and power prices”.

title: US Dollar: Inflation-driven rate risks and premium – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that stronger-than-expected core US inflation has pushed market pricing toward a near-certain Federal Reserve rate hike this week and higher odds of another move by year-end.
